skillset.skill: 12s CT - 2000% Water DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 10. If this Skill crits, increase own Arts by an additional 30.
skillset.arts: 30000% Water DMG (PHY). Each time own Arts is used, permanently increase own ATK by 25% (MAX: 250%), Super CRI rate by 5% (MAX: 50%), and permanently reduce own MAX HP by 9% (MAX: 90%).
skillset.truearts: 70000% Water DMG (PHY). For 60s, reduce enemies' PHY RES by 50% (stackable). Additionally, for each enemy defeated by this True Arts, increase own Arts by 100.
skillset.superarts: 200000% Water DMG (PHY). If there is another Spirit ally in party, increase own Arts by 50. For 30s, increase own CRI DMG by 200%.

passive.ability1: If ownself is not affected by Status ailments, increase own CRI rate by 100% and Super CRI rate by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [1% × own ATK/100].
passive.ability3: Increase own Break Power by [1% × own ATK/100].
